title: Patrol
wikitext:
The term [[patrol]] refers an [[NPC]] or [[mob]] of NPCs, usually hostile, which moves along a set path rather than wandering around within a small radius or standing still. 

The [[affiliation]] of patrols may differ from one patrol to another on the same map, so sometimes patrols will fight each other without player intervention. Learning to [[aggro]] and separate a patrol from other mobs is a key tactic in making encounters with numerous hostile enemies easier and vital in surviving difficult areas of the game.

==Notes==
*Enemies on patrol will stop moving if there is no player within roughly a compass range and a half worth of distance of them, when arriving at their next point along their patrol route.
